Живу и работаю в Санкт-Петербурге. Заним: I live and work in Saint Petersburg. I have been working with generative art since 2021.
Я работаю с видео, анимацией и инсталляц: I work with video, animation and installation. I am interested in how the continuous flow of images changes our perception: what we notice, what we stop feeling, and how we distinguish our own experiences from those imposed on us. My work explores information overload, memory and everyday life: how familiar images shape our sense of the world, or prevent us from seeing it.
Материалом для меня становятся поп-культ: My materials include pop culture, memes, everyday scenes, gestures and phrases. Through transformations, repetition and unexpected combinations, I look for other ways of reading them. An ordinary polite phrase can unfold into a natural landscape, a funny character can become a way of speaking about hope, and an endless succession of images can reveal the repetition of a single state.
Мне близка искренность, которая не отмен: I value sincerity that leaves room for irony. I do not want to ignore anxiety and contradictions, but neither do I want hopelessness to become the only way of speaking about the present. For me, humour is a way of staying connected to the world without dismissing its complexity. I want to notice the warmth, curiosity and simple joy of living that remain beneath the noise.
В работе я соединяю код, 3D, нейросетевы: I combine code, 3D, neural-network tools, compositing and editing. Technical complexity is not an end in itself: I choose my methods to suit the idea, movement and rhythm of a work. I am also interested in a contradiction within my practice: I use image-making technologies to speak, among other things, about exhaustion caused by their excess.
Я стремлюсь к понятному визуальному язык: I aim for a clear visual language that leaves room for the viewer. I do not want to explain everything or insist on a single correct interpretation. I want to leave enough space for someone to recognise their own experience, imagine the rest of a story, or briefly step outside the familiar flow and notice what they feel.
Как я пришёл к нейросетям: How I Came to Work with Neural Networks
В 2021 году я начал создавать генеративн: In 2021, I began making generative art and visualisations with JavaScript. I published works on NFT platforms, including fxhash. In 2022–2023, I became part of the NFT movement and started exploring emerging neural-network tools.
Начинал с Disco Diffusion, затем работал: I started with Disco Diffusion, then worked with early versions of Midjourney. In Midjourney, I looked for prompt glitches: combinations of words that produced unexpected images and revealed the tool’s own visual language.
С появлением Stable Diffusion меня всё б: With the arrival of Stable Diffusion, I became increasingly interested in controlling generation. I used ControlNet, trained
, разбирался в анимации с AnimateDiff. И: , and explored animation with AnimateDiff. I studied early versions of ComfyUI and gradually made it the main tool in my practice.
Этот путь связал программирование, экспе: This path brought together programming, image experimentation and movement. I now combine them in video art, animation and installations, choosing tools to suit each idea.
Ранее работал под псевдонимом St Laurent: I previously worked under the name St Laurent Jr (stlaurentjr). I was a member of the Berezovy Prompt art group, which has since ceased its activities.

Дефиле в костюмах Льва Бакста — Тоша Пет: A Fashion Show in Costumes by Léon Bakst — Tosha Petrov
Дефиле в костюмах Льва Бакста: A Fashion Show in Costumes by Léon Bakst
Визуализация и анимация костюмов по эски: Costume visualisation and animation based on Léon Bakst’s sketches. Art direction, script and editing.
в Третьяковской галерее я создал десятим: at the Tretyakov Gallery, I created a ten-minute video fashion show: twenty costumes from the artist’s sketches became realistic garments in motion. The exhibition marks the 160th anniversary of Bakst’s birth.
Я отвечал за визуализацию и анимацию кос: I was responsible for costume visualisation and animation, art direction, the script and editing. The music was composed by
В основе — подиумный выход, соединённый: The work combines a runway presentation with theatrical and ballet poses. Bakst worked in theatre, and I wanted to preserve that connection: the characters’ movements draw on historical photographs of performers wearing his costumes.
Костюмы прорабатывал вместе с кураторами: I developed the costumes with curators who had studied Bakst and his work in depth. Every detail mattered: three layers of fine silk, a satin ribbon, the way a scarf was wrapped, and the buttons fastening a cape.
Если на шляпке три пуговки, обёрнутые тк: If a hat has three fabric-covered buttons, it must have three fabric-covered buttons. No rhinestones, even if they look prettier.
За время работы освоил и новый для себя: During the project, I also learned a new vocabulary of details: a chemisette, a cameo ornament, and black scalloped trim sewn to a dress.
Рабочий стол: эскизы, референсы и вариан: My workspace: sketches, references and costume variations.
Сначала собирал примерный вид наряда спе: I first assembled an approximate front, side and back view of each outfit. Then I refined the details: correcting a shape, making fine silk transparent, or replacing feathers on a headdress. I transferred successful elements through masks in an image editor, then regenerated individual parts. Piece by piece, step by step.
Использовал Qwen Image, Nano Banana и мн: I used Qwen Image, Nano Banana and extensive manual work. A single costume took anywhere from five hours to two days. The curators and I refined the details until the result matched the sketch.
Этапы работы: от эскиза к проработанному: The process: from sketch to a fully developed costume.
Для анимации использовал MiniMax в Comfy: For animation, I used MiniMax in ComfyUI. I planned scenes second by second, gathered references and wrote detailed prompts, sometimes as long as ten thousand characters. ChatGPT helped format them for the model; I then checked and refined every scene manually.
Для финального десятиминутного ролика сг: For the final ten-minute film, I generated around five hundred videos. I selected movements from them and assembled a sequence of runway appearances for twenty outfits.
Третьяковка доверила мне разработку сцен: The Tretyakov Gallery entrusted me with the script and overall visual direction. I developed the characters, lighting, movement and action within each shot so that every appearance expressed the character of its costume.
Музыку доверил дорогому другу: I entrusted the music to my dear friend
. Как и в нашей работе для Суздаля, он п: . As in our work for Suzdal, he found music in these silent movements, combining fashion beats with an orchestral sound. Just as we like it. Dima worked closely with feedback, and together with the curators we brought the score to its final form.
Это единственная инсталляция на выставке: This is the only installation in the exhibition with sound. In the edit, the music and the characters’ movements came together as a single fashion show.

«Окно в память» — групповая выставка сем: Window into Memory was a group exhibition of seven digital artists at the ZIL Cultural Centre. It explored a generation whose coming of age coincided with the digitisation of everyday life, and the devices through which we learned to see the world.
Носители распределили между авторами слу: Display technologies were assigned to artists at random during preparation: slide projectors, old televisions, smartphones and other devices helped shape the works. The medium itself became part of the artistic statement.
Моя работа — зацикленная видеоанимация о: My work is a looping video animation about endless information consumption. Characters with animal heads replace one another within a recursion of screens. A malfunction interrupts the flow, but everything then begins again.
Образы и форматы меняются, создавая ощущ: Images and formats change, creating a sense of variety. Beneath that change, the same cycle repeats: overload, recovery, forgetting one’s exhaustion, and returning to familiar consumption.
